name: Shape-generic lossless BF16 lm-head backend integrated with vLLM
hypothesis: An unquantized BF16 ParallelLMHead with a large vocabulary is often an M=1 bandwidth bottleneck during decode. A lossless sign/mantissa plus exponent-delta layout can reduce weight traffic while retaining the stock path for unsupported shapes.
expected_global_effect: Reduce batch-1 decode time without changing the GPTQ-Marlin backbone, scheduler, attention, vocabulary partitioning, sampling, or model weights.

preserved_dependencies: the original BF16 weight remains loaded and is the fallback source
every packed weight value reconstructs the original BF16 bit pattern
tensor-parallel gather, vocabulary padding, logits scaling and sampling stay in stock LogitsProcessor
all non-M=1, biased, non-BF16, non-contiguous and ineligible heads use the stock quantization method
changed_boundaries: eligible unquantized ParallelLMHead weights receive a non-persistent auxiliary layout after loading
eligible M=1 decode projections use a warmed Triton reduction with a different legal FP32 accumulation order
prohibited_rewrites: no additional quantization, changed checkpoint values, approximate vocabulary, shortlist, speculative decode or altered sampling
dependency_contract.numerical_ordering: The packed layout is bit-exact, but the FP32 reduction tree is not bitwise identical to every cuBLAS algorithm. Standard floating-point tolerance is supportable; strict cross-process token identity requires a separate deterministic baseline contract.

evidence.claim: The production profile attributes a material decode contribution to the output head.
